egress.terms: 800 GB a month on the 256 MB plans, stated as a plan line; no overage rate and no post-quota policy published on the page read

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: KVM with root and full administrative access per the vendor FAQ, on an IPv6 or NAT'd IPv4 address, sold through a WHMCS install; no API documented on the page read. A NAT-only address means no inbound port without a tunnel.
chaining: At USD 4.99 a year this is the cheapest host in evaluated offerings by an order of magnitude, and 800 GB a month on a 10 Gbps port is more transfer than any other sub-dollar plan here; 256 MB of RAM and a NAT'd address make it a DNS secondary, an IPv6-only health probe or a tunnel endpoint, not a crawler.

limits.value: 800 GB a month is 26 GB a day, 2.6 percent of the 1 TB daily transfer ceiling, and it is the whole point of the plan: 800 GB a month is 160 times the 5 GB disk, so this is a relay with a large pipe relative to its RAM.
